fb_text:
Every new guy's first week goes the same way. Forty calls to the owner. Where do I park? What's the gate code? Does the loading dock take deliveries after ten?

You're mid-job, mid-drive, mid-dinner — walking somebody through details you already know by heart.

This crew's first week went different. He asks the bot, gets the answer in seconds, does the job. The gate code, the contact, what got flagged last visit — it's all in the log, and the log answers.

He learns the route. You keep your evenings.

I built FieldNotes for my own business — a commercial plant service company running 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area. It works because your crew already knows how to send a text.

Try the 60-second demo, no signup: fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
